answer_1.quote: this paper presents the UnSupervised and Reference free (USR) evaluation metric for dialog.

answer_2.quote: Standard automatic metrics for language generation correlate poorly with human judgement of dialog.

answer_4.quote: human quality annotation was collected for models trained on the Topical-Chat and the PersonaChat corpora
answer_4.guideline: Each response was given six different scores: Understandable (0-1), Natural (1-3), Maintains Context (1-3), Interesting (1-3), Uses Knowledge (0-1), Overall Quality (1-5).
